text: Yup! Their system doesn’t always save the documents. I submitted my entire visa application and every single document was not saved on their end…though it is in your rights to file an objection…the likely result, even in that case, will be that you have to submit the application again. TBH, I’d bite the bullet, expedite the process, and just file again. The process with the MH is to Do…and remedy error’s after. Feel free to DM me…best of luck.
